novelty_search.nearest_invalid: Frozen upstream lexicon v1 cleared causal bars but was invalid because 2/32 A bases failed its all-rows capability rule.
novelty_search.new_question: Does the identical frozen program transfer to a third disjoint lexicon under the pre-existing v7 population-capability standard while retaining every row?

prospective_boundary.scope: Third lexicon shift within registered constructions, not unrestricted syntax OOD.

capability_policy.provenance: The v7 fresh-construction authority preregistered 0.85 for A/P cells and 0.75 for C; this v2 uses those population bars before model access rather than postselecting rows.
capability_policy.A_cells: For each A1/A2 x direction cell, pooled base+donor native accuracy >=0.85.
capability_policy.P_cells: For each direction, scored donor-source native accuracy >=0.85.
capability_policy.C_cells: For each direction, actual-task base native accuracy >=0.75. Intermediate feature sign is not capability.

frozen_program.actuator: alpha = frozen intercept+slope*resid10 intermediate unembedding contrast; patch resid18_source+alpha*q. No confirmation resid18 margin, donor activation, outcome IDs, search, or outcome selects alpha.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_capability_a: All hashes/disjointness and registered capability cells pass; local resid10 functional identity <=1e-4 and exact resid18 head <=1e-3.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_upstream_program: Every finite alpha uses only the frozen program inputs and no forbidden confirmation input.
predictions.pred_c_new_lexicon_A_prediction: A1/A2 each have mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75 across all rows.
predictions.pred_d_new_lexicon_P_generalization: P mean reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75 across all rows.
predictions.pred_e_new_lexicon_C_selectivity: C mean normalized unrelated effect <=0.20 across all rows.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: 64 unique rows within 25 counted forwards, 328 example evaluations, 224 selected-head pairs, zero grids/backwards/updates, four inherited parameters, and 64 records.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: the frozen upstream read-compute-write interface predicts a population-capable third lexicon.
terminal.null: Authority/program/coverage pass but A/P prediction or C selectivity misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, population capability, local exactness, head, frozen program, or coverage fails.
